title: Example recording script for record-demo.mjs. Copy it to video/beats.json, then rewrite the steps from the beat sheet in docs/demo-script.md: one or more steps per beat, holds sized to each beat's voiceover window.

steps.note: Beat 1. Open on the calm state from a reset link. No cursor movement; let the caption carry the hook.
steps.caption: The problem, in one line
steps.detail: Beat 1: the hook. One sourced number, said in the first 10 seconds.

steps.note: Beat 2. Type the exact input from the beat sheet. A typing delay lets the viewer read it.

fill.text: Paste the exact input string from the beat sheet here

steps.caption: One real input, typed live

steps.note: Beat 3. Click, wait for the result, then caption the result.
steps.caption: The answer and its reasons
steps.detail: Every number on screen comes from a tool, not the model.

steps.note: Beat 4. Bring the decisive frame to the centre and hold it a full beat.
steps.caption: The money shot: hold it

steps.note: Caption the slow part before it starts; a caption set inside a sped-up step is gone too fast.
steps.caption: A live model run, sped up
steps.detail: The badge in the corner says how much.

steps.note: A slow live call. It records in real time and plays 4x faster in demo.mp4 with a speed badge.
Beat 5. The contrast: a legitimate input stays quiet. Deep links make the beat repeatable.
steps.caption: A legitimate input: no alarm
steps.detail: The contrast beat shows it does not cry wolf.

steps.note: Beat 6. The proof page: measured numbers, with where each one comes from.
steps.caption: Measured, not claimed
steps.detail: One command re-measures every number on this page.

steps.note: Beat 7. Close on the live URL, on screen and spoken.
steps.caption: app.example.com
steps.detail: Live now. Code, tests and the beat sheet are in the repo.
